newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mosaix estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mosaix estimate raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Mosaix Inc to $1.10/shr from $1.07 after the company reported first quarter earnings that exceeded Hambrecht's expectations.
-- The investment firm maintained its 1998 estimate of $1.35/shr and its buy rating on the stock.
-- Mosaix reported earnings of $0.21/shr before charges versus $0.19 one year ago.

-- In a statement, Hambrecht said Mosaix's near-term operations indicate "business as usual" with management focused on individual business segments. It also said that products will be rolled out in a controlled manner throughout 1997.
